title: Initial Configuration Oracle Component
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, bit strings $x$ and $\beta$, and natural numbers $v$ and $s$, the third oracle component on the encoded input consisting of $x$, $\beta$, the binary representation of $v$, and the binary representation of $s$ returns true exactly when the pairing of $x$ with the two binary representations of $v$ and $s$ belongs to the initial-configuration language of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
